<!-- AUTOGENERATED by eng/DocsGen. Do not edit; run `dotnet run --project eng/DocsGen`. -->

The projects a scaffold run creates.

| Key | Type | Default | Effect | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | — | Implemented | Project name. Must be unique, compared case-insensitively. |
| `type` | [project type](/scaffold/project-types/) | `DotnetWebapi` | Implemented | One of the [project types](/scaffold/project-types/). |
| `path` | string | — | Implemented | Path relative to the workspace root. May not contain `..`. |
| `framework` | string | — | Implemented | Target framework moniker for .NET projects. |
| `variables` | map<string, string> | — | Implemented | Values available to this project's templates. |
| `dependencies` | string[] | — | No effect | Runtime package dependencies. **See KL-006.** |
| `devDependencies` | string[] | — | No effect | Development-only package dependencies. **See KL-006.** |
| `directories` | directory[] | — | Implemented | Directories to create inside the project. |
| `files` | file[] | — | Implemented | Files to create inside the project. |
| `references` | string[] | — | Implemented | Names of other declared projects to reference. |
| `features` | string[] | — | No effect | Named features to enable. **See KL-006.** |
| `architecture` | string | — | Implemented | `clean-architecture` or `vertical-slices`. See [architecture](/scaffold/architecture/). |
| `layers` | layer[] | — | Implemented | Custom layers, used when no named architecture is set. |
| `entities` | entity[] | — | Implemented | Domain entities to generate. |
| `dtos` | dto[] | — | Implemented | Data transfer objects to generate. |
| `endpoints` | endpoint[] | — | Implemented | HTTP endpoints to generate. |
| `services` | string[] | — | Implemented | Service names to generate. |
| `pageObjects` | pageObject[] | — | Implemented | Page objects for a test project. |
| `specs` | spec[] | — | Implemented | Test specifications for a test project. |
| `fixtures` | fixture[] | — | Implemented | Fixtures for a test project. |

:::note[Not yet implemented]
**`dependencies`, `devDependencies`, and `features` have no effect.** All three keys are parsed and validated, then ignored. No package reference or feature is emitted.

Add packages with a `postScaffoldCommands` entry such as `dotnet add package <name>` or `npm install <name>`.

_Tracked as [KL-006](/reference/known-limitations/#kl-006) · Applies to CLI 1.2.1_
:::
